# Skal din aktieportefølje have et servicetjek?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode (15 Oct 2026) with Christian Kongsted (eToro) and Benjamin Bjerre (Techwave). It covers a tech sell-off after a hot US CPI print: the Kospi fell 7%, and SK Hynix and Samsung dropped sharply. The guests stay bullish on long-term AI infrastructure (ASML, TSMC, Micron, AMD, Lumentum, Cloudflare) but flag debt-financing risk at neoclouds like CoreWeave and Oracle. Kongsted advocates a barbell portfolio 'service check' using correlation analysis, adding defensives in healthcare (J&J, Merck), insurance (Travelers), energy (ConocoPhillips, Exxon, Neste) and banks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AMD — AMD | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Kongsted recently increased position; Bjerre agrees with thesis.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted sees AMD becoming a credible Nvidia competitor and growing GPU share from ~7% to 10-15%. Rack-scale solutions and lower prices support this. Guest Bjerre adds that agentic AI is driving CPU demand. Momentum is positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if GPU market share gains stall
- if AI capex financing cracks

> *"jeg har forstørret min position i AMD for nylig, fordi jeg synes, at de har en interessant position i markedet"*

---

### 🟢 ASML — ASML | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Techwave holds and is positive long term; demand into 2029-2030; Kongsted calls it a strong bid but avoids it.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bjerre holds ASML (lower half of allocation) and stays bullish long term because of its unique EUV monopoly and service margin gains. Guest Kongsted calls it a strong European pick but avoids it because lumpy quarterly sales add volatility. The 5% drop was seen as a possible buying opportunity.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese lithography closes the tech gap
- if AI capex financing breaks down

> *"Vi har den i portføljen. Den er i den lavere halvdel i forhold til allokeringen, men vi har den og er egentlig ret positive på den."*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Both guests hold; Q3 beat with 68% growth.

#### Reasoning

Both guests own TSMC. Kongsted prefers its stable, growing sales over ASML's lumpiness. The strong quarter confirms high demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI demand slows
- if financing for datacenters dries up

> *"Jeg er investeret i TSMC blandt andet"*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Both guests hold Micron for memory exposure.

#### Reasoning

Memory capacity is reportedly maxed out and demand is strong. Kongsted watches memory prices as a key indicator. Bjerre notes Chinese competition and wants to reduce memory exposure somewhat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory chip prices fall
- if Chinese overproduction floods market

> *"jeg har Micron på hukommelseschips"*

---

### 🟡 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Techwave holds a large position; buys dips at times but aims to cut memory exposure.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bjerre treats volatility as an occasional buying opportunity. However, the fund wants to reduce memory exposure because the memory cycle is unprecedented and hard to forecast 3-4 years out.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory prices roll over
- if Chinese memory competition intensifies

> *"Vi har faktisk noget tid gerne, vi vil nedbringe lidt vores eksponering mod memory"*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Debt-financed neocloud; rising CDS, technical trend turning negative.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted expects financing problems to show up first at debt-funded neoclouds. CoreWeave's CDS is rising and its technical trend has turned negative. Guest Bjerre ties its 16% fall to interest-rate sensitivity.

> *"vi ser også CoreWeave en af de aktier, som ligesom går fra at være en positiv trend rent teknisk til en negativ trend"*

---

### 🟠 ORCL — Oracle | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Rising CDS and doubts over datacenter affordability.

#### Reasoning

The host and Kongsted cite Oracle's rising CDS and a datacenter it questioned affording as warning signs of AI financing stress.

> *"Man kan se, at Oracles CDS, som er den her forsikring på, hvis deres gæld ikke skal kunne betale sig tilbage, den har været stigende."*

---

### 🟢 JNJ — Johnson & Johnson | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Kongsted bought it as a defensive anchor: AAA rating, broad portfolio, low valuation.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted calls J&J a 'backstop' in his barbell portfolio. It has low correlation to tech, a AAA credit rating, pharma plus medtech breadth, and a historically low valuation. AI-driven efficiency gains are longer-term upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if healthcare correlation to tech rises
- if valuation re-rates far above history

> *"Super solidt selskab, så man kan sige, at i det her marked kan det også fungere som et virkelig solidt anker i porteføljen"*

---

### 🟢 MRK — Merck | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Bought as low-volatility healthcare ballast.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted upgraded his healthcare exposure because the sector is low-volatility and has long underperformed, which offsets tech risk.

> *"inden for sundhedssegmentet købte Johnson & Johnson, jeg købte Merck"*

---

### 🟢 TRV — Travelers | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Insurance position bought for defensiveness.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted added Travelers as a low-volatility financial to diversify away from tech.

> *"jeg købte også lidt inden for forsikring, der har jeg Travelers"*

---

### 🟢 NESTE.HE — Neste | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Sustainable aviation fuel supported by EU/US mandates; acted as a portfolio cushion.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted holds Neste for the structural SAF demand from EU and US mandates, which cut CO2 by 80% as a drop-in fuel. Diesel prices and Middle East tensions are a short-term tailwind. He may not hold it forever.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SAF mandates are weakened
- if diesel/energy prices collapse

> *"Det er ikke nødvendigtvis sådan, at jeg skal holde den for altid, men det er i hvert fald noget, som har været med til at agere som stødepude i min portfølje."*

---

### 🟡 COP — ConocoPhillips | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Held as an inflation and oil hedge.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted holds large US energy stocks to benefit if inflation is oil-driven.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices fall

> *"Jeg har nogle af de store amerikanske energiaktier, ConocoPhillips og Exxon"*

---

### 🟡 XOM — Exxon Mobil | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Held as an inflation and oil hedge.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted holds it as defensive energy exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices fall

> *"Jeg har nogle af de store amerikanske energiaktier, ConocoPhillips og Exxon"*

---

### 🟢 PANW — Palo Alto Networks | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Kongsted holds; early access to frontier AI models; cheaper than CrowdStrike.

#### Reasoning

Guest Kongsted owns Palo Alto because it and CrowdStrike were first to receive Anthropic's new model, which puts them at the front of AI-era security. He prefers PANW on valuation. Bjerre sees cybersecurity as a defensive tech theme.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation becomes stretched
- if it loses frontier-model partner status

> *"Så synes jeg, at de personligt har en lidt mere rimelig prissætning end CrowdStrike. Derfor har jeg så valgt at ligge i Palo Alto."*

---

### 🟠 CRWD — CrowdStrike | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Super interesting per Kongsted, but pricier than Palo Alto.

#### Reasoning

It has the same early frontier-model access thesis as PANW, but Kongsted prefers PANW on price. Bjerre lists it among cybersecurity beneficiaries.

> *"Men begge de to virksomheder er super interessante inden for det område."*

---

### 🟢 NET — Cloudflare | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Techwave has benefited greatly; agentic AI platform and network visibility.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bjerre highlights Cloudflare as a key cybersecurity/AI-agent holding. It has a global datacenter footprint, protects most websites, and lets customers build agents on its platform. Cybersecurity has been less volatile.

> *"en af de selskaber, vi har haft rigtig stor glæde af i portføljen, det er Cloudflare faktisk"*

---

### 🟢 LITE — Lumentum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

One of Techwave's larger positions; optical interconnect for GPU clusters; Nvidia invested.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bjerre sees connectivity as an AI bottleneck: growing GPU clusters need light-based interconnects, which Lumentum supplies. Nvidia's investment supports the thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if datacenter buildout slows

> *"Ja, vi har den i portføljen, også en af de større positioner."*

---

### 🟡 BE — Bloom Energy | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Techwave holds a fuel-cell datacenter power play; volatile alongside AI stocks.

#### Reasoning

Guest Bjerre holds it for the energy-bottleneck theme. It had a great year but falls with AI names because hyperscalers fund it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler capex is cut

> *"Nu har vi et selskab, der hedder Bloom Energy, som leverer nærstrøm til, når man skal bygge de her datacenter."*

---

### 🔴 CEG — Constellation Energy | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Techwave sold its position.

#### Reasoning

Bjerre mentions selling Constellation from the fund. No reasoning is given.

> *"Vi har haft blandt andet Constellation Energy, den solgte vi fra."*

---
